en: Zephaniah 3

zh: 耶路撒冷的罪惡和救贖

p.src: 1  Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!

en: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!
u.src: 1  Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!

p.src: 2  She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in the LORD. She didn’t draw near to her God.

en: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in the LORD. She didn’t draw near to her God.
u.src: 2  She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in the LORD. She didn’t draw near to her God.

p.src: 3  Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.

ja: にいる君主たちは、ほえる
en: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
u.src: 3  Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.

p.src: 4  Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.

en: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.
u.src: 4  Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.

p.src: 5  The LORD, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.

ja: におられる主は義なる方であり、
かすことがない。しかし
en: The LORD, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.
u.src: 5  The LORD, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.

p.src: 6  I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

en: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.
u.src: 6  I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

p.src: 7  I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

ja: まいは断ち滅ぼされず、彼女について
en: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
u.src: 7  I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

p.src: 8  “Therefore wait for me”, says the LORD, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

ja: めた。全地は私のねたみの
en: “Therefore wait for me”, says the LORD, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
u.src: 8  “Therefore wait for me”, says the LORD, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

p.src: 9  For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

en: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
u.src: 9  For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

p.src: 10  From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

ja: 、私を礼拝する者たちが、私へのささげ
en: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.
u.src: 10  From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

p.src: 11  In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.

ja: で、もう高ぶることはない。
en: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.
u.src: 11  In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.

p.src: 12  But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.

en: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.
u.src: 12  But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.

p.src: 13  The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”

en: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”
u.src: 13  The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”

p.src: 14  Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.

en: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
u.src: 14  Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.

p.src: 15  The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

ja: におられる。あなたはもう
en: The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.
u.src: 15  The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

p.src: 16  In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”

en: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”
u.src: 16  In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”

p.src: 17  The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

ja: いをもたらす勇士である。主は喜びに満ちてあなたを
声を上げてあなたのゆえに
en: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
u.src: 17  The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

p.src: 18  I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.

ja: たちを、私はあなたから取り除く。彼らはあなたの重荷、あなたのそしりであった。
en: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.
u.src: 18  I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.

p.src: 19  Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.

ja: けていた者たちに、称賛と
en: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.
u.src: 19  Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.

ja: 3:19 「見よ」と訳されたヘブル語הִנֵּהは、「見なさい」「注意を向けなさい」「よく見なさい」という意味を持ち、しばしば間投詞として用いられる。
en: 3:19 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 20  At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.

ja: れて来る。その時、あなたがたを
en: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.
u.src: 20  At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.
